description: On the counter in front of you are a yellow lemon-shaped item, a small white duck-like piece, a blue block-shaped piece, a small tube, and an open cardboard box to the right with a white board leaning behind them. The left hand stays planted on the left side of the counter while the right hand reaches in from the right to pick up and remove the yellow item, then lifts the small tube to inspect it and sets it away, then grasps the white duck-like piece and moves it off to the right, and finally grips the blue block and lifts it up from the surface.
